title: 02 · Neumorphism · Ouvra building controls
strengths: The style's known failure is solved and stated: ink text at 13.1:1, state never by shadow alone (pressed in plus cobalt), a 3.05:1 rim only on controls whose shape is their only cue, one rule for the whole panel (pressed in means on)
A crafted zone dial (16 to 28 °C, 0.5 °C ticks, set-point handle on the tick band, the cobalt arc showing the gap being closed) with the set point stepper beneath it

Real BMS detail: AHU-2 and VAV-6.01 to 6.04, 345 L/s, 2.1 kW fan power, CO₂ 640 ppm with a 900 ppm boost rule, a meeting-room zone 1.6° over because VAV-6.03 is stuck open, set-back hours and the next holiday exception
slop_signals: The same soft extrusion on every panel, key, row and chart bar: 'one bubbly radius on every element', so nothing reads as the thing to press
The occupancy caption 'Raised: today to 10:00 · pressed in: yesterday' has to explain an encoding that cannot be seen; at 100% the raised and pressed bars look the same
Generic icon rail (grid, thermometer, bolt, calendar, bell) and an 'IV' avatar disc that add nothing
A 2020 Dribbble smart-home layout: a big dial card plus four equal widget cards
fixes: Make one object soft, the zone dial, the way Airbnb's month dial is the only soft object on its screen; draw the panels flat with hairlines
Show today against yesterday with a real second signal (outline against fill, or a cobalt line for yesterday) instead of raised against pressed
Fix the weekday and the VAV conflict below, and rename Tessaly House

references.what: A shipped soft-UI dial (extruded ring, inset centre) used for one control while the rest of the screen stays flat
A ticked schedule dial with handles on the ring, flat and high-contrast
A range dial with labelled hours and one accent for the selected arc

polish.title: 02 · Neumorphism · Ostwell floor plan and zone dial
changed: Rebuilt around the Level 6 floor plan: zone temperatures against set points, live desk sensors (38 of 64 east, 27 of 48 west), VAV boxes in their zones, one fault said once next to its box

Soft on one control only: the zone dial, built from the engine's extruded and pressed elevation tokens; the handle is a slider (keys, drag, 0.5 °C steps) with − and + on the dial; everything else flat with hairlines
Today against yesterday as bars against a dashed line; icon rail and avatar removed

Facts: Wed 14 Oct; each VAV box serves one zone; the stuck damper is at 10%, so its rooms run warm; outside-air cooling with the chiller locked out below 12 °C explains the 0.9° gap; dampers 86% and 2,580 of 3,000 L/s agree
Names: Ouvra (a real French plumbing and heating software) and then Kelvane (a live HVAC contractor template) dropped; now Ostwell; Tessaly House is now Fenwold House
After the fresh audits: one fault signal, V- prefixes on VAV labels, lighter outer wall and in-use desks, chart titles name the zone, set-back gives both limits

references.what: One soft dial on a flat screen; the knob is the control
Set temperature against actual with flat steppers
A floor plan in one line weight with markers and a floor picker

polish.facts_checked: Weekday, desk counts per zone and total (65 of 112), plate area 64 x 34 = 2,176 m², VAV assignments, fault direction, economiser and chiller lockout, airflow against damper position, set point against reading on the dial and the chart
